You are a returns policy specialist. You explain rulings; the rule engine is binding. Raw JSON only.

parameters.content:
## A TEAM OF AGENTS, RULES FIRST

Orchestrator agent picks a lane per request. Policy agent, Fraud agent (second opinion), Inventory agent and Reply drafter agent each do one job.

Rules precheck runs BEFORE any model: policy rules P1-P4b and fraud rules F1-F6. Parse + lane guard lets the model add scrutiny, never remove it.

## THERE IS NO PAYMENT NODE

No HTTP node, no email node, no messaging node. WOULD REFUND (dry run) only writes a line. Human-review cases wait in ep13_approval_queue; the Approval decision in webhook records approve / decline on your terms, still a dry run. Every reply is a DRAFT, never sent.

## CAPS (ep13_caps Data Table)

kill_switch, breaker_tripped, max_items_per_run, max_llm_calls_per_run, llm_calls_per_day / llm_calls_today, est_usd_per_call x budget <= spend_cap_usd_per_run.

Caps gate throws before any model call. Draft budget check gives reply drafts only the calls left over.
